paper.core_task: Unsupervised reinforcement learning for exploration and downstream adaptation

contributions.name: Diffusion-based intrinsic reward for unsupervised exploration
contributions.author_claim_text: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to introduce diffusion models into unsupervised RL, enabling accurate modeling of heterogeneous state distributions and defining a score-based intrinsic reward that substantially improves exploration.
contributions.description: Uses a diffusion model trained on a replay buffer to estimate state density and define a score-based intrinsic reward that encourages exploration of under-visited states.

contributions.name: Decoupled training and diffusion policy fine-tuning algorithm
contributions.author_claim_text: Beyond exploration, ExDM develops an efficient decoupled training scheme and a finetuning algorithm for adapting pre-trained diffusion components to downstream tasks under limited interaction, with theoretical guarantees of convergence and optimality.
contributions.description: Decouples modeling from acting by using a lightweight Gaussian policy for action selection, and provides an alternating optimization procedure with theoretical convergence guarantees for fine-tuning diffusion policies.

novelty_claims.text: The proposed method is novel and interesting.
